name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.
usageSnippet:
<Sheet>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <button ...props>Open</button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Edit profile</@title>
  <@description>
    Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
  </@description>
  ...
</Sheet>

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Human readable label for the dialog, in event the dialog title is not rendered

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the dialog when the escape key is pressed

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the dialog when the outside is clicked

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the dialog when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the dialog.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial active trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the active trigger value.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is closed

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the dialog. Useful for composition.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is opened

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

props.name: persistentElements
props.description:
Returns the persistent elements that:
- should not have pointer-events disabled
- should not trigger the dismiss event

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Whether to prevent scrolling behind the dialog when it's opened

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the dialog was opened

props.name: role
props.description: The dialog's role

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Show the top-right close button. Defaults to true.

props.name: side
props.description: `"top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"` — which edge the sheet slides in from.

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Whether to trap focus inside the dialog when it's opened

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The controlled active trigger value

events.name: onEscapeKeyDown
events.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function to call when the dialog's open state changes

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onRequestDismiss
events.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

events.name: onTriggerValueChange
events.description: Function to call when the active trigger changes

examples.title: Side
examples.source:
import Sheet from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/sheet/sheet.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
<@trigger|props|> <@title>Top sheet <@description>Slides in from the top edge of the screen. <@trigger|props|> <@title>Right sheet <@description>Slides in from the right edge of the screen. <@trigger|props|> <@title>Bottom sheet <@description>Slides in from the bottom edge of the screen. <@trigger|props|> <@title>Left sheet <@description>Slides in from the left edge of the screen.
examples.description: Pass `side` to set which edge of the screen the sheet slides in from: `top`, `right`, `bottom`, or `left`.

examples.title: No Close Button
examples.source:
import Sheet from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/sheet/sheet.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Sheet showCloseButton=false>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Open Sheet</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>No Close Button</@title>
  <@description>This sheet doesn't have a close button in the top-right corner. Click outside to close.</@description>
</Sheet>
examples.description: Pass `showCloseButton={false}` to hide the close button in the top-right corner. Click outside, or provide your own `@footer` action, to close.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Sheet from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/sheet/sheet.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko"; import Label from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/label/label.marko";
<@trigger|props|> <@title>تعديل الملف الشخصي <@description>قم بإجراء تغييرات على ملفك الشخصي هنا. انقر حفظ عند الانتهاء.
<@footer>
examples.description: The `dir` prop is a native attribute pass-through — set it on `<Sheet>` to flip logical-property layout and typography for right-to-left languages. Every RTL example on this site does it the same way: a `dir="rtl"` wrapper plus Arabic labels.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Sheet from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/sheet/sheet.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
{ open = next; } > <@trigger|props|> <@title>Controlled sheet <@description>This sheet's open state is held in the parent and can be toggled from outside too. open: ${String(open)}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: an `open` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `openChange`.

composition:
`Sheet` composes its anatomy from attr-tags (plus its own default body) instead of separate components:

```text
Sheet
├── @trigger   — render prop; spread the given props onto your own trigger element
├── @title     — heading text, wired to the dialog's aria-labelledby
├── @description — supporting text, wired to the dialog's aria-describedby
├── (body)     — the scrollable content
└── @footer    — optional actions row, e.g. Save / Close buttons
```

There is no separate close-button slot: the close button is rendered automatically (see `showCloseButton`).
